description: Schaduwkaart fiets- en wandelpaden per buurt (2024) is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. De kaart in geeft een indicatie van het gemiddelde schaduwpercentage op wandel- en voetpaden per buurt in 2024 in de provincie Zuid-Holland. Ook kun je zien waar de schaduw vooral van bomen of van gebouwen komt. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are beweegvriendelijkheid, bewegen, fietsen, fietspad, gezondheid. It offers 4 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/HTML, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PNG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-08-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
